A packet for a history unit, written as `.qmd` pages with the packet kit's history and assessment blocks: source cards (a picture with numbered markers, facts at a glance, notes in English and 中文, context, how to cite it), source investigations, a design challenge, a short-answer test with marks, and a paragraph task with a command term, a rubric and a planner. Copy the folder (`course/guide/02-chalkline/examples/example-mesopotamia/`, or `guide/examples/example-mesopotamia/` in Chalkline) into `course/units/`, then change its words.

**The packet:** [student booklet](example-mesopotamia-packet.pdf) · [teacher edition](example-mesopotamia-teacher-packet.pdf) (A3, folded; the Trail theme).
